[[Category:Contract]]
A '''contract''' is a '''legally-binding agreement''' between [[legal entities]]. Legal entities participating in a contract are called '''parties''' to the contract.<ref>{{#cite:Q3952}}</ref>

A contract

* identifies the participating legal entities
* specifies the '''terms''': the rights and obligations of each party

== Format ==

A contract is most commonly '''written''', however, some [[jurisdictions]] also accept '''oral contracts'''.

== Basis ==

Contracts are formed on the principle of '''mutual consent'''.

i.e., to form a contract

* each party must consent freely, without coercion, to the terms of the contract;
* they must express this consent
** in the case of a written contract, often via dated signatures
